source_only_baseline.qualification: Source answer explored response contract, helper, options, and config beyond frozen question. Its saved tool-returned count was 51,196 bytes; exact command replay on the same checkout returned 56,838 raw stdout bytes because the first tool result had been truncated.

atlas_map_build.scope: Includes discarded draft runs where present; excludes model prompt/output telemetry and independent reviewer tool output.

comparison_limits: Raw UTF-8 stdout bytes are an output-volume proxy, not model tokens or total prompt context.
Setup instructions, independent reviewer tool output, and model drafting/review time were not measured comparably.
Direct-source task elapsed time was unavailable, so build/use time cannot be compared end to end.
Atlas map-build cost is additional to the mapped-answer output; no amortized token-saving claim follows from three questions.
